Messages.Author: Miller
Messages.Body:
Hi folks,

What happens when Victor Gerard successfully calls a Praxis Seizure (let's say Praxis Seizure: Paris)? Can he actually keep the title?

Name: Victor Gerard
[AU:C]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 2
Capacity: 7
Discipline: cel dom for obf AUS PRE
Anarch: You and Victor can play cards requiring a Camarilla vampire as if Victor were a Camarilla vampire. While Victor is a Baron, you and Victor can play cards requiring a Prince as if Victor were a Prince.
Artist: Gábor Németh

Name: Praxis Seizure: Paris
[DS:U2]
Cardtype: Political Action
Requires a Camarilla vampire. Title.
If this referendum is successful, put this card on the acting vampire to represent the unique Camarilla title of Prince of Paris. This could lead to a contested title. If the prince is Toreador, his or her capacity increases by 1.
Artist: L. A. Williams

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
I'd say this is similar to  Mata Hari playing a Fee Stake . He gets the title, but after the action stops faking Camarilla and is back to his Anarch sect: the title becomes dormant, he gets it back if he switches to Camarilla and looses it immediately if he gets another title or if another Prince/Baron/Archbishop of Paris emerges.

If this is right, a good follow-up may be: can he play an Anarch Secession ? Faking Camarilla and getting his dormant title back for the duration of the action ?

Anarch Secession

+1 stealth action. Requires a ready, non-anarch, titled vampire.
This vampire becomes Anarch. If he or she had a city title, put this card on him or her as a title card to represent the title of baron of the same city. Minions without titles cannot block this action.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Miller wrote:
> Hi folks,
>
> What happens when Victor Gerard successfully calls a Praxis Seizure (let's say Praxis Seizure: Paris)? Can he actually keep the title?
>
The title is dormant as long as he it Anarch.

> lip wrote:
> If this is right, a good follow-up may be: can he play an Anarch Secession ? Faking Camarilla and getting his dormant title back for the duration of the action ?
>
Anarch Secession doesn't require a Camarilla vampire for a start. Even when Gerard is faking Camarilla to play a card, he doesn't benefit from the Praxis -- only the card he is playing sees him as a Camarilla vampire.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
